items.title: Gldrive
items.content: A trial lesson is the organising point for GL Drive. Intensive-course options, instructor information, reviews and FAQs sit around that first step, while mobile-friendly registration keeps the move from comparison to signup short.
items.excerpt: Driving-school site that puts the trial lesson first, supported by course options, instructor information, reviews and FAQs.

items.title: Yco-it
items.content: YCO IT turns complex risk-management, compliance and certification services into a structured B2B WordPress journey. ISAE, ISO, information-security, control and advisory topics are separated into understandable service routes, supported by quickscan and consultation actions plus recruitment content for a second audience.
items.excerpt: YCO IT separates risk management, compliance, certification, consultation and recruitment into audience-specific routes.

items.title: Bedrijfspostadres
items.content: Bedrijfspostadres turns a business-address service into a guided online application experience. Visitors can compare packages, review locations and post-processing options, use a package-choice helper and start a structured application for a business or registration address directly from the website.
items.excerpt: Bedrijfspostadres combines package comparison, location proof, a choice helper and a guided online application.

items.title: Dmelektro
items.content: Electrical systems, lighting, PV installations, batteries, heat pumps and maintenance define the technical-service scope of DM Elektro. The WordPress structure gives each solution a clear route while connecting technical expertise, certification context and quotation or contact actions.
items.excerpt: Electrical and sustainable-energy site with dedicated pages for systems, PV, batteries, heat pumps and maintenance, supported by expertise context and quote access.

items.title: Fixfinder
items.content: Vehicle choice is the first filter in Fixfinder, replacing a generic garage-service list. Visitors can choose from maintenance, APK, repair and specialist services, understand the booking process and move toward an appointment without having to navigate a traditional garage website first.
items.excerpt: Automotive platform that starts with the vehicle, then narrows into maintenance, APK, repair and specialist services before appointment booking.

items.title: Voicelinq
items.content: Professional translation and interpreting services give VoiceLinq a focused business proposition. Responsive content separates the specialist language offer clearly and keeps enquiry access close for organisations or individuals seeking support.
items.excerpt: VoiceLinq combines translation and interpreting services with concise positioning and direct enquiry routes.

items.title: Quicktemp
items.content: QuickTemp organizes a staffing business around employer needs, candidate applications and clear sector-specific routes. The site covers hospitality, production, logistics and horticulture while connecting service information, client proof, reviews and a direct candidate signup flow.
items.excerpt: Recruitment site with separate employer and candidate paths, supported by sector information, client proof and a direct signup route.

items.title: Vchetwonder
items.content: VC Het Wonder organizes midwifery information around the stages that matter most to expectant parents: pregnancy, birth and postnatal care. Care information and multiple practice locations sit within a calm responsive structure, with contact actions available at the relevant stage of the maternity journey.
items.excerpt: Midwifery site organized by pregnancy, birth and postnatal care, with practice locations and contact actions kept close to each stage.

items.title: Super Simple Internal Links
items.content: Keyword-to-URL automation inside existing WordPress content is handled by Super Simple Internal Links. Its HTML-aware processing avoids existing links, scripts, styles, code blocks and buttons, while per-page limits, CSV import/export, reporting and optional integrations cover WooCommerce, ACF, Elementor and widgets.
items.excerpt: Internal-linking automation that maps keywords to URLs while protecting existing HTML elements and limiting how many links can be added per page.

items.title: Starkeuken
items.content: A WordPress website for a kitchen and interior specialist with a broad offer spanning kitchens, appliances, bathrooms, sanitary products and tiles across multiple showroom locations. Product categories and showroom information frame the decision, while visual presentation and advice actions help visitors move from browsing to a showroom conversation.
items.excerpt: Kitchen-specialist WordPress site built around product categories, showroom information and a clear handoff from inspiration to advice.

items.title: AC Drive
items.content: AC Drive turns a driving-school website into a direct path from first visit to lesson enquiry. The experience brings together a free trial lesson, transparent lesson packages and prices, a clear four-step route to the driving licence, customer proof and direct contact options in one responsive WordPress structure.
items.excerpt: AC Drive frames the driving-school decision around a free trial lesson, package comparison, a four-step licence path and reviews.

items.title: Image Usage Scanner
items.content: A read-only WordPress media audit plugin for finding repeated image usage across featured images and ACF image or gallery fields. It processes larger sites in controlled batches, keeps scan state resumable, reports where media is used and provides CSV export without deleting or rewriting files.
items.excerpt: Read-only media audit that shows where featured and ACF images are reused, keeps large scans resumable and exports findings without modifying files.

items.title: Course Dates Manager
items.content: A WordPress course-management plugin that stores course schedules in a dedicated content model and publishes them through responsive listings and a public REST API. Administrators manage start dates, course type, times, meetings, registration status and available places from one structured workflow.
items.excerpt: WordPress course-management plugin with structured schedule data, responsive listings, filters and paginated REST API endpoints.

items.title: AI Patch Runner
items.content: AI Patch Runner is an admin-only WordPress developer tool for reviewing, previewing, applying and rolling back structured JSON patch packages for installed plugins. Production patching is blocked by default and requires both trusted server-side configuration and an explicit admin setting before writes are allowed.
items.excerpt: Admin-only WordPress patch workflow for structured JSON review, preview, controlled apply and rollback with production writes disabled by default.

items.title: ACF CSV Manager
items.content: ACF CSV Manager focuses on the spreadsheet-first side of my WordPress content tooling: exporting ACF and page text for structured review, then importing validated edits back through a controlled admin workflow. CSV/XLSX handling, upload validation, import preparation and progress feedback make larger content updates reviewable before WordPress writes are processed.
items.excerpt: Spreadsheet-first WordPress content workflow for exporting ACF/page text, reviewing edits and importing validated CSV/XLSX changes safely.

items.title: Modern Image Manager
items.content: A WordPress media-management plugin for reviewing image metadata, importing and exporting updates, scanning image usage and creating controlled media ZIP exports from one admin interface. The workflow combines bulk operations with capability checks, validation and safer file-handling boundaries.
items.excerpt: Media admin workflow that combines metadata review, usage scanning, CSV-based updates and controlled ZIP creation behind validation and capability checks.

items.title: ACF Page Text Manager
items.content: Centralized editing of text-oriented WordPress fields is the purpose of ACF Page Text Manager. The custom admin tool brings ACF fields, page and post titles, excerpts, Yoast and Rank Math metadata, and image text into one workflow, with inline editing and validated CSV/XLSX import and export for larger reviews.
items.excerpt: Central WordPress text-management tool for ACF, Yoast/Rank Math metadata, image text, titles and excerpts with validated CSV/XLSX workflows.

items.title: Spring architecten
items.content: For Spring Architecten, my contribution focused on a portfolio-led presentation where architectural projects remain the visual priority. Large project photography, spacious layouts and direct project browsing are supported by clear mission and team content on desktop, tablet and mobile.
items.excerpt: Architecture portfolio work focused on project-led layouts, large imagery, clear browsing and responsive presentation for Spring Architecten.

items.title: SEO Image Assistant
items.content: Shutterstock image handling moves into the WordPress editorial workflow with SEO Image Assistant. The plugin combines OAuth-based access, keyword and page-based search, mapped ACF fields, queued suggestions, licensed-asset recovery and capability-gated REST endpoints inside the admin.
items.excerpt: Editorial stock-image workflow that keeps page context, licensing state and ACF image mapping inside WordPress before the asset reaches the media workflow.

items.title: Dcaschoonmaak
items.content: Reliable housekeeping and cleaning personnel are the immediate business focus of the DCA Schoonmaak hotel-staffing site. Role-based staffing content, a clear working process and trust signals lead hotel decision-makers toward a personnel request.
items.excerpt: Hotel-staffing site built around housekeeping roles, a working process, trust signals and personnel requests.
